title: List the account IDs of female clients born before 1950 who reside in distr
question: List the account IDs of female clients born before 1950 who reside in districts where the average salary is between $8,000 and $9,000, and whose accounts had total transaction amounts exceeding $10,000 in 1997.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district AS di ON c.XCL_012 = di.XCL_017
JOIN trans AS t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND c.XCL_011 < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
  AND t.XCL_048 BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY a.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000

FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district AS di ON c.XCL_012 = di.XCL_017
JOIN trans AS t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND c.XCL_011 < '1950-01-01'

  AND t.XCL_048 BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY a.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000

SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district di ON c.XCL_012 = di.XCL_017
JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', c.XCL_011) < '1950'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1997'
  AND di.XCL_031 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
GROUP BY a.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 10000
